title: Second-order upper bound for the tangential Jacobian of I + tL when trace(P_S L) = 0
statement:
Second-order bound for the area Jacobian. For all P ∈ ℕ and Λ ∈ ℝ there is C ∈ ℝ such that for every linear subspace S ⊆ ℝ^P, every linear map L : ℝ^P → ℝ^P with operator norm ‖L‖ ≤ Λ and trace(P_S∘L) = 0, and every t ∈ ℝ with |t| ≤ 1:
 √det(((I + tL)∘ι_S)*((I + tL)∘ι_S)) ≤ 1 + (t²/2)·Σ_{j=1}^P (|L(P_Se_j) − P_S L(P_Se_j)|² − P_Se_j·L(P_S L(P_Se_j))) + C|t|³,
where P_S is the orthogonal projection onto S, ι_S : S → ℝ^P the inclusion, * the adjoint for the inner products of S and ℝ^P, det the determinant of an endomorphism of S, and e_j = EuclideanSpace.single j 1.
lean_statement: ∀ (P : ℕ) (Λ : ℝ), ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ (S : Submodule ℝ (Euclid P)) (L : Euclid P →L[ℝ] Euclid P), ‖L‖ ≤ Λ → LinearMap.trace ℝ (Euclid P) (S.starProjection.toLinearMap ∘ₗ L.toLinearMap) = 0 → ∀ t : ℝ, |t| ≤ 1 → Real.sqrt ((((ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ (Euclid P) + t • L).comp S.subtypeL).adjoint ∘L ((ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ (Euclid P) + t • L).comp S.subtypeL)).det) ≤ 1 + t ^ 2 / 2 * ∑ j : Fin P, (‖L (S.starProjection (EuclideanSpace.single j 1)) - S.starProjection (L (S.starProjection (EuclideanSpace.single j 1)))‖ ^ 2 - inner ℝ (S.starProjection (EuclideanSpace.single j 1)) (L (S.starProjection (L (S.starProjection (EuclideanSpace.single j 1)))))) + C * |t| ^ 3
